Yes. This is the opening of Kafka's *Die Verwandlung*, and even this short excerpt offers a strikingly original idea. A man wakes up transformed into a monstrous insect, yet his thoughts drift to ordinary things: the bad weather, his sleeping position, his job as a travelling salesman.

The flat, matter-of-fact treatment of an absurd catastrophe gives the reader a new way of seeing alienation, dehumanization and the grip of routine on modern life. The unease it provokes stays with the reader well beyond the plot itself.
